tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the event print and merchandise categories quoted in Singapore (name cards, lanyards, roll-up banners, tote bags, backdrops, merch, flyers, packaging), which ones get an instant price, and the spec fields each needs.

tools.name: quote_event_print
tools.description: Get an instant all-in price (SGD, GST and delivery included) and guaranteed ready-by date for event print and merch in Singapore: name cards, printed lanyards, roll-up banners, tote bags. Pass the deadline to see options that make it, including same-day to 5-day rush. Use for conferences, launches,

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Submit a custom or rush request that has no instant price (backdrops, custom merch, unusual specs, or deadlines faster than any instant option). Returns a reference; a firm price and date is sent to the contact email. Singapore delivery only.

tools.name: rush_order_status
tools.description: Check the status of a custom or rush quote request by its reference.
